title: Larger product video viewing area
summary: Videos now use the full product gallery height instead of a short landscape-only frame.

changes.detail: Removed the forced 16:9 gallery height for videos. Square and portrait videos use the same responsive stage as photos while contain fitting preserves the complete frame.
Removed media-dependent gallery height changes, avoiding vertical layout jumps when switching between video and photos.
